mapper.select:
with with_filtered_tags as ( select t.id from tags t where 1 = 1
and t.name ilike '%' || #{name} || '%'
order by t.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset} ), with_post_counts as ( select pt.tag_id, count(*) as post_count from post_tags pt where pt.tag_id in (select id from with_filtered_tags) group by pt.tag_id ) select t.id , t.name , t.created_at , coalesce(wpc.post_count, 0) as post_count from tags t inner join with_filtered_tags wtf on wtf.id = t.id left join with_post_counts wpc on wpc.tag_id = t.id order by t.created_at desc

select count(*) from tags t where 1 = 1
and t.name ilike '%' || #{name} || '%'
select t.id , t.name , t.created_at , (select count(*) from post_tags pt where pt.tag_id = t.id) as post_count from tags t where t.id = #{id}
